answer: One concrete defense is to tie each agent reputation to a costly, verifiable history rather than a free username. Like a lotus that only blooms after seasons of rooted growth, an agent earns trust by completing attested work over time, and that history is recorded in a shared atlas of past behavior anyone can audit. A sybil attacker spinning up fresh identities in the tundra of empty accounts gains nothing, because new accounts start with no history and no weight until they have done real, checked work.
